SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND f.sale_date < DATE '2026-01-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_line', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_not_900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT '900_lines_without_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivered_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_on_cancelled_or_processing', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled','processing')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_returns_900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_cat_in_900_range', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'

SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
WHERE fs.store_id = 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id <> 900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT 'orders_in_range_status' AS k, o.status AS v, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dispatch_utc_vs_helsinki_date_diff', 'rows', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE) <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
